characters.summary: In Titans: Beast World, Beast Boy turns himself into a Starro-type star conqueror nicknamed Garro to stop the Necrostar. Garro's spores spread worldwide, turning infected people into feral humanoid animals that carry Beast Boy's consciousness and seek out the strongest beings they can find.

techniques: Spores that turn people into feral humanoid animals under his influence
Spores that instinctively target the strongest beings available

weaknesses: Can be maimed by boom tube attacks (lost an arm to Cyborg's boom tube)
Can be killed by teleporting a being into his body (Chester Runk)
limitations: Beast Boy's own memories and control can be stripped from the form (Doctor Hate)
characters.formDifferences: A star-conqueror (Starro-type) form, Garro, built around spore infection and mass transformation rather than Beast Boy's individual animal shapeshifting.

sources.supports: Beast Boy becomes the star conqueror Garro to stop the Necrostar; spores turn people into feral humanoid animals with his consciousness; loses an arm to Cyborg's boom tube; Doctor Hate erases his memories; killed when Chester Runk is teleported into him.
Base Beast Boy powers, including his healing factor.

unknowns: Removed unsupported claims of telepathic coercion, enhanced durability, flight and swimming for this form.
Garro's size, flight and individual combat feats are not stated in the source.
Exact issue for Garro's death within Titans: Beast World #1-6 and tie-ins.

characters.continuity: DC Comics Modern Age / New Gods
characters.summary: Big Barda is a New God warrior from Apokolips with strength roughly parallel to Wonder Woman's, durability approaching invulnerability, and expert combat training. Her Mega-Rod lets her fly, generate energy, teleport and manipulate gravity.

mechanisms: Resistance to disease and most toxins

weaknesses: Not established: the source lists only resistances; she has been badly wounded (Injustice League, Queen Bee) and defeated (Doctor Impossible, Earth 2)
limitations: Flight, teleportation and gravity effects depend on the Mega-Rod

sources.supports: Strength roughly parallel to Wonder Woman, near-invulnerability, Apokoliptian battle armor, Mega-Rod (flight, energy, teleport, gravity), fights with Knockout (draw), Lobo, Queen Bee and Doctor Impossible.

notableResults.citation: Secret Six (issue not stated in source)
notableResults.note: Long hand-to-hand fight that ended in a draw.
Defeated by Doctor Impossible; Kalibak then cast her out of Darkseid's army.

conditional.ability: Flight, teleportation, energy and gravity manipulation

campaignTags.claim: Uses the Mega-Rod, a New God device that grants flight, energy generation, teleportation and gravity manipulation.
The Mega-Rod lets her fly.

unknowns: Removed an unsupported Wonder Woman sparring draw; the source only says she is 'an immediate match' for Wonder Woman.
Removed 'powered-armor': the source describes battle armor that enhances durability, not a powered suit (owner ruling: standard-issue armor does not count).
Exact upper limits of her New God strength.

characters.summary: Bizarro is an imperfect Superman duplicate with inverted powers: arctic (freeze) vision instead of heat vision and flame breath instead of freeze breath, plus flight and invulnerability. Green kryptonite empowers him; only blue kryptonite harms him.
limitations: Post-Crisis clone's body crumbled slightly each time it exerted itself

sources.supports: Arctic vision and flame breath, flight and invulnerability, blue kryptonite weakness, Superman: The Man of Steel #5 clone destroyed colliding with Superman.

notableResults.note: The clone was destroyed when it collided with Superman in mid-air.

campaignTags.claim: Has Superman-duplicate flight.
Arctic vision freezes anything on contact.
Flame breath exhales a superheated substance.

unknowns: Corrected: freeze comes from his vision and fire from his breath, not the other way round.
Power levels vary across clones and reboot eras.

characters.summary: Black Adam draws on Egyptian gods for stamina, speed and flight, strength, wisdom, magic lightning and near-invulnerability. He fights with overwhelming force and bursts of mystic lightning, but saying 'Shazam' reverts him to mortal Teth-Adam.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to magic-based trickery and spells that can trick him into uttering his own transformation word
limitations: Reverting to human form if tricked into saying his magic word

sources.supports: Egyptian-god powers incl. flight and lightning; 'Shazam' reversion weakness; 52 World War III rampage and power loss; JSA and Captain Marvel fights.

feats.claim: During World War III, defeated the Marvel Family, Global Guardians, Doom Patrol and Teen Titans in a week-long rampage.
Defeated Death in Bialya with a barrage of mystic lightning.

notableResults.opponent: Captain Marvel and a JSA/mystic coalition
notableResults.note: Captain Marvel and mystics stripped his powers with a lightning spell; he escaped as a mortal.
Tricked into saying 'Shazam', then knocked into amnesia.
Defeated after trying to destroy Superman and Captain Marvel.

campaignTags.claim: Speed of Horus grants him flight.
Derives all abilities from ancient magical deities.
Power of Aten allows bursts of electricity and lightning, used offensively (e.g., against Death).
Power of Aten allows bursts of electricity and lightning, used offensively (e.g., against Death).

unknowns: Removed 'spellcaster': speaking his transformation word is not spellcasting.
Removed unsupported 'rapid cellular recovery'.
Power fluctuations depending on which pantheon era is active.

characters.summary: Black Canary (Dinah Laurel Lance) is a master of many martial arts whose Canary Cry is portrayed as ten times stronger than typical sonic weapons, able to break metal; she can even glide long distances by screaming downward.

techniques: Martial arts (Aikido, Judo, Krav Maga, Muay Thai, Wing Chun and more)
Pressure-point and Five Heavens Palm techniques

limitations: Canary Cry depends on her voice

sources.supports: Canary Cry power and gliding, list of martial arts, covert-operations proficiency, Shiva encounters (no result), capture of White Canary.

feats.claim: Canary Cry can break metal and is portrayed as ten times stronger than typical sonic weapons.
Captured White Canary of the Twelve Brothers in Silk.
feats.citation: Birds of Prey (issue not stated in source)

campaignTags.claim: Can glide long distances by screaming downward with the Canary Cry.

unknowns: Removed an unsupported win over Lady Shiva: in Birds of Prey vol. 2 #6 the duel (with Huntress) was halted; Best of the Best (2024) result not given.
Removed 'infiltration': the source notes covert-ops proficiency but no specific infiltration feat (owner ruling: a role is not enough).
Exact Canary Cry limits across reboots.

characters.summary: Black Lightning (Jefferson Pierce) generates large amounts of bioelectricity to stun or kill, uses his electromagnetic field as a shield and to hurl ionized objects, and is a skilled martial artist.
weaknesses: A Gene-Bomb (Invasion!) made him lose control of his powers
limitations: Lost his powers psychosomatically after Trina Shelton's death until Batman helped him regain them

sources.supports: Bioelectricity, electromagnetic shield, martial arts, psychosomatic power loss, Gene-Bomb, and fights (Ishmael, Holocaust, Amazo).

feats.claim: Helped the Justice League fight the revived Amazo.
feats.citation: Justice League (issue not stated in source)

notableResults.citation: Black Lightning (issue not stated in source)
notableResults.note: Defeated Tobias Whale's shapeshifting servant together with Gangbuster.

campaignTags.claim: Generates and projects electricity natively.
Manipulates electrical currents and creates electromagnetic barriers.

unknowns: Removed 'natural-flight' and flight mobility: the source does not mention flight or levitation.
Exact maximum voltage output.

characters.summary: Black Manta is a mercenary and Aquaman's archenemy whose armored suit provides unlimited air, enhanced strength, ocean-pressure resistance and insulation, with helmet lasers that cut carbon steel; he is also a skilled swordsman and marksman.

techniques: Helmet lasers that cut carbon steel
Hidden weaponry built into his gear

limitations: Relies entirely on mechanical suit integrity for power and life support

sources.supports: Suit features (air, strength, pressure resistance, insulation), carbon-steel-cutting helmet lasers, weapons skills, and Aquaman fights (Brightest Day #19-20, Justice).

notableResults.note: Defeated in their final clash during the Hall of Doom attack.

campaignTags.claim: Suit provides unlimited air and resistance to ocean pressure for underwater operation.
Suit provides unlimited air underwater.
Armored suit grants enhanced strength and mounts helmet lasers.
Suit and helmet lasers capable of cutting carbon steel.
Hidden weaponry built into his gear.

unknowns: Removed 'swimmer': no propulsion or swimming-speed feat in the source.
Killed Arthur Curry Jr. (issue not given in source).
Suit upgrades across reboots.

characters.summary: Jaime Reyes is bonded to the Reach scarab Khaji Da, whose armor forms an energy cannon, foot-long blades, a sword and shield, and wings for flight that also act as shields. It grants superhuman strength and durability and can discharge energy that neutralizes magic.

mechanisms: Wings and shield used as barriers

weaknesses: The scarab can shut down for long periods (27 days after hacking the Reach army)
limitations: Infiltrator Mode (fighting without Jaime's restraint) is used only reluctantly

sources.supports: Armor weapons, wings, magic-neutralizing discharges, Khaji Da breaking from the Reach (Blue Beetle #25), the Reach negotiator fight (#35-36), Infiltrator Mode.

feats.claim: Attacked the Reach flagship and, with the scarab, was ready to sacrifice himself to stop a Reach doomsday device (saved by Booster Gold).

campaignTags.claim: The scarab forms a full-body armor granting superhuman strength and durability.
Alien Reach scarab weaponry: energy cannon, blades, grappling hook.
Scarab armor wings provide flight.

unknowns: Removed unsupported sonic weakness, armor regeneration and super-speed.
Full potential of scarab weapon configurations.

notableResults.note: Took the negotiator on a kamikaze dive that killed him and badly injured Jaime.

characters.id: dc:Blue Beetle (Jaime Reyes)|Khaji Da Full-Control Beetle
characters.summary: In this state, the Scarab Khaji Da maintains total active control of the host body, unlocking its maximum lethality, unrestricted weapon generation, and peak tactical combat processing without human hesitation.

techniques: Infiltrator Mode: scarab fights without Jaime's restraint

weaknesses: Not established in the cited source
limitations: Jaime and the scarab avoid this mode except in desperate situations
characters.formDifferences: Removes Jaime Reyes's human consciousness from the driver's seat, allowing the Scarab to operate at peak weapon efficiency and ruthlessness with zero hesitation.

sources.supports: Infiltrator Mode: a taller, spiked form that lets the scarab fight without Jaime's restraint, used only in desperate situations; Khaji Da gains its own personality (Blue Beetle #25).

unknowns: needs-review: the cited page has no 'full control' mode for Khaji Da. The closest documented form is Infiltrator Mode. Confirm which comic or film depiction the roster form refers to before scoring it above base Jaime.
Removed unsupported tachyon barrages, sub-atomic disruption and host-strain claims.

characters.summary: Booster Gold is a 25th-century time traveller whose power suit grants superhuman strength, speed and durability, with energy-blasting gauntlets, a force field and a Legion flight ring. His robot companion Skeets carries tools and weapons, and he travels in Rip Hunter's Time Sphere.
weaknesses: Suit damage and malfunctions (Ted Kord's replacement suit often malfunctions)

sources.supports: Power suit, gauntlets, force field, flight ring, Skeets, Time Sphere, and fights (Chiller, Doomsday, Devastator, Maxwell Lord, Mister Mind).

feats.claim: Helped stop Mister Mind and save the multiverse.

notableResults.citation: Booster Gold (issue not stated in source)
notableResults.note: Stopped the shapeshifter from killing and replacing the U.S. President.

notableResults.citation: Booster Gold (issue not stated in source)
notableResults.note: Nearly killed and lost an arm.
